note: Three separate stone pads on the west side of Medix Grade Road (shown as Medix Run Road in some apps) beside Medix Run, placed from the Little Medix Road junction: 006 is 100 ft north of it, 007 0.35 mile south and 008 0.75 mile south. Each is a shaded gravel back-in that the booking page lists as a moderate driveway grade, with a picnic table and 30 ft of overhead clearance; the pads are 15 ft wide, and the agency's campsite map layer says none has room for a camper with its awning out. Vehicles must stay on the stone pad. The stream is in the woods beside the road, not at the pads. No toilet; drinking water is more than a quarter mile away. Pack out trash. --Claude
